note: Searched ArcGIS Online/Hub and the web for Starr County zoning districts. No county zoning layer is published: the county GIS offerings are parcels, roads and city limits (paid shapefiles), and the Starr CAD and Parisi pilot services have no zoning. Rio Grande City, Roma, Escobares and La Grulla publish no zoning map or GIS service that we could find; Escobares says it enforces a zoning ordinance but publishes no map data. Only zoning maps as images or third-party sites (Zoneomics) were found.
